title: 第三章 超人叔叔第四章 调戏警花
content_zh:
“哎，大哥，我劝你可别多管闲事，刚才那几个人不好惹，是咱这一片出名的黑社会。”吧台后的妹子见林昆有些愣神，好心的劝告道。
“呵呵……”
林昆笑了笑，一口喝光了杯里的酒，“妹子，谢谢你的好心，可哥我就爱管闲事。”说完，掏出二百块钱的小费拍在桌子上，转身向门外走去。
与此同时，百凤门三楼的总经理办公室里，一个一身黑色西服的男领导，正向站在窗边的黑衣女人报告，“蒋姐，疯彪的手下光头刘又下药带走一个姑娘。”
蒋叶丽侧身俯视着窗外，磕了磕手里夹着的烟灰，淡淡的道：“不用管他们。”
“这已经是第十个姑娘了，再任疯彪的手下这么搞下，我担心会对我们不利，一方面会影响我们的客源，另一方面警察那边一旦问罪起来……”
“阿东，你说的没错，可那也没办法。”
蒋叶丽深吸了一口烟，淡淡的道：“自打武哥去世以后，疯彪就盯上了百凤门，他明面上不敢和我怎么样，暗地里却让他的狗在我的场子里‘拉屎撒尿’，我要是忍不住现在这口气，他疯彪立马就会像疯狗一样咬过来，到时候我要是再想保全百凤门，可就没那么容易了。”
“蒋姐，可总这样下去也不是办法啊。”
“再等等……咱们华夏不是有句话古话么，多行不义必自毙，他疯彪一直这么下去，总会有人出来收拾他的，但不是我。”说完，蒋叶丽俯视着楼下，嘴角突然促狭的一笑，“阿东，你过来看看，那个人出现了……”
光头刘领着五个小弟，一路连拉带拽的把章小雅拖到了停车场，章小雅被捂着嘴，想叫也叫不出声，想哭也哭不出声，奋力挣扎也是徒劳，泪水绝望的从她的眼眶里流了出来，她从来也没像现在这么害怕过。
难道自己真的要被这群混蛋给XX了？早知道这样干嘛出来买醉啊，不就是失个恋么……可现在说什么都晚了，要是真被XX了，那自己就去死！
一辆商务车旁，光头刘几个人停了下来，拉开车门先把章小雅塞了进去，然后悉数坐进车里，上车前光头刘还在打电话：“彪哥，今天晚上这小妞绝对正点，我和兄弟们马上给你送过去……好的好的……”
挂了电话，光头刘得意洋洋的坐进了车里，冲旁边的小弟吩咐道：“开车！”
小弟发动了车子，抬起头，全车的人都懵了——不知道什么时候，车的机关盖上坐了个人，这兄弟背对着车窗，懒懒散散的坐在那儿叼着半根烟卷举头望明月，时不时的还吐出个飘逸的烟圈来，当真是够装逼。
“次奥！”
光头刘最先回过神，光溜溜的脑袋探出车窗就怒骂道：“你特么的谁啊，赶紧给老子滚下来！”
林昆慢悠悠的回过头，叼着烟卷咧嘴一笑，道：“我只说一遍，把那女孩放了。”这本来很有气势的一句话，从他嘴里说出来一点杀伤力都没有。
光头刘眉头一皱，怒从火中来，发狠道：“小子，你特么的找死吧！”
林昆笑着不说话。

光头刘冲旁边的小弟吩咐道：“开车，把这孙子给甩下去！”
小弟踩下油门，松开了手刹，刚要把车开走，就见林昆突然从机关盖上跳了起来，抬起脚隔着车窗的钢化玻璃就向正驾驶的小弟踩了过来。
喀嚓……
车里所有的人都没反应过来，林昆那44码的大脚已经踩穿了钢化玻璃，径直的踩在了开车小弟的脸上，那小弟闷哼一声，嘴巴鼻子里鲜血一起流，整张脸被踩的扭曲，直接昏死了过去。车里其他人全都惊讶的张大了嘴巴！
这时，旁边不远处的一辆红色轿跑车里，五岁大的楚澄兴奋的挥着小手，冲楚静瑶道：“妈妈……妈妈，你快看！那儿有一个超人叔叔！”
content_en:
"Hey, brother, I advise you not to meddle in other people's business. Those people just now are not easy to mess with. They are a well-known underworld in our area." The girl behind the bar saw that Lin Kun was a little stunned and kindly advised.
"Haha..."
Lin Kun smiled and drank the wine in the glass in one gulp. "Sister, thank you for your kindness, but I just like to be nosy." After saying that, he took out a tip of 200 yuan and slapped it on the table, turned around and walked out the door.
At the same time, in the general manager's office on the third floor of Baifeng Gate, a male leader in a black suit was reporting to the woman in black standing by the window, "Sister Jiang, Crazy Biao's bald Liu drugged and took away a girl."
Jiang Yeli turned sideways and looked down out of the window, knocked the cigarette ashes in her hand, and said calmly: "Don't worry about them."
"This is already the tenth girl. If Feng Biao's men do it again, I'm worried that it will be detrimental to us. On the one hand, it will affect our customer base, and on the other hand, if the police start to investigate..."
"A Dong, you are right, but there is nothing we can do about it."
Jiang Yeli took a deep breath from her cigarette and said calmly: "Since Brother Wu passed away, Crazy Biao has been eyeing Baifengmen. He doesn't dare to do anything to me on the surface, but secretly lets his dog 'poop and pee' in my place. If I can't hold back my current tone, Crazy Biao will bite me like a mad dog immediately. If I want to save Baifengmen again, it won't be that easy."
"Sister Jiang, it's not an option to continue like this."
"Wait a minute... We have an old saying in China, those who do evil will be punished by themselves. If he keeps acting like this, someone will come out to deal with him, but it won't be me." After saying that, Jiang Yeli looked downstairs, with a sudden narrow smile at the corner of her mouth, "A Dong, come here and take a look, that person has appeared..."
Bald Liu led five younger brothers and dragged Zhang Xiaoya to the parking lot. Zhang Xiaoya's mouth was covered and she couldn't scream or cry. Her efforts were in vain. Tears flowed out of her eyes in despair. She had never been so scared before.
Are you really going to be fucked by these bastards? If I had known this, why would I go out to get drunk? Isn't it because I lost my love... But now it's too late to say anything. If you really get fucked, then you will die!
Next to a business car, Bald Liu and several other people stopped, opened the door, stuffed Zhang Xiaoya in first, and then all got into the car. Before getting in the car, Bald Liu was still on the phone: "Brother Biao, this girl is definitely on point tonight, my brothers and I will send it to you right away... Okay, okay..."
After hanging up the phone, Bald Liu got into the car triumphantly and ordered the boy next to him: "Drive!"
The younger brother started the car and raised his head. Everyone in the car was stunned - at some point, someone sat on the hood of the car. This brother had his back to the car window, lazily sitting there with half a cigarette in his mouth and looking up at the bright moon. From time to time, he would blow out an elegant smoke ring. He was really pretentious.
"Cio!"
Bald Liu was the first to come to his senses. He stuck his bald head out of the car window and cursed angrily: "Who the hell are you? Get out of here!"
Lin Kun slowly turned around, held a cigarette in his mouth, grinned, and said: "I'm only going to say it once, let the girl go." This originally powerful sentence had no lethality at all when it came out of his mouth.
Bald Liu frowned, anger rising from the fire, and said fiercely: "Boy, you are looking for death!"
Lin Kun smiled and said nothing.
Bald Liu Chong ordered the boy next to him: "Drive, throw this grandson off!"
The younger brother stepped on the accelerator and released the handbrake. Just as he was about to drive away, he saw Lin Kun suddenly jump up from the hood, lift his foot and step towards the younger brother who was driving through the tempered glass of the car window.
Click...
No one in the car reacted, Lin Kunna 4The size 4 feet had already stepped through the tempered glass, and stepped directly on the face of the driver. The driver groaned, blood flowed from his mouth and nose, and his whole face was distorted by the step, and he passed out directly. Everyone else in the car opened their mouths in surprise!
At this time, in a red coupe not far away, five-year-old Chu Cheng excitedly waved his little hand and said to Chu Jingyao: "Mom...Mom, look! There is a superman uncle there!"
